messages:
sam: Quick heads-up — planning release in change window 2026-03-22 02:00-03:00 UTC. Need cross-service pin: API -> v2.3.0, runtime kernel -> kv-batch-v4, console -> ui-qt7, router -> header-swap-v2. Canary plan: 5% for 15m, then 25% for 15m, then 100%; rollback if 5xx > 3% or p95 latency +200ms. Anyone object?
neha: runtime ok for kernel bump but we need KV cache warmup. Suggest pre-warm job 30m before and a node-group label change so kernelset-4 nodes get traffic.
jordana: console side: we need to gate migration behind a feature flag (ui_migrate=true). I'll keep it on canary only until 25% green. Also a note: session cookie name changes, will add to release notes.
mike: router needs header-compat fallback. I'll deploy router config change with a header rewrite and a compatibility fallback that routes to legacy-v1 if header mismatch > 0.5%. Schedule config push at t+5 after API pinned.
sam: deploy sequence proposal: 1) pin API image 2) kernel bump on runtime (pin nodes) 3) router config change 4) console feature flag flip (canary only) 5) scale canary from 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Agree?
neha: agree but runtime pre-warm must run before the canary. I will post Job to prewarm K/V and warm KV caches.
mike: router rollback plan: revert header-swap config and route back to legacy-v1; verified we have traffic mirror to test infra.
jordana: release notes: i'll include console breaking-change section about cookie rename and a how-to for clients. Drafting now.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] scheduled release window 4643210000, plan pinned: API:v2.3.0, runtime:kv-batch-v4, router:header-swap-v2, console:ui-qt7. Canary steps: 5% (15m) -> 25% (15m) -> 100% (10m). Auto-halt on guard triggers.
sam: added automated guards: deploy-bot will auto-halt if 5xx > 3% for 10m OR error count delta > 50 in 10m OR p95 increases by >200ms. ops-shepherd please confirm alert routing.
ops-shepherd: will add pagerduty escalation and alerts to #eng-oncall + #eng-releases. Also adding a runbook entry with exact thresholds.
neha: pre-warm job posted: kubectl apply -f prewarm-kv.yaml
```
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: kv-prewarm
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: prewarm
        image: gcr.io/redwood/kv-prewarm:stable
        args: ["--duration=900", "--keys=100000"]
      restartPolicy: Never
```
mike: i'll watch router metrics: header_mismatch_rate, route_error_count, and upstream_5xx. thresholds set in grafana dash.
jordana: console flag is staged on canary only, will not flip globally until we get green at 25%.
sam: ok lockstep then. Please reply with 'ready' when your piece is set. Target go at 4643210300 UTC.
neha: ready :white_check_mark:
mike: ready :thumbsup:
jordana: ready — docs link: https://go/release-notes/464321
release-bot: [release-bot] release notes draft created: https://go/release-drafts/464321
sam: deploying in 2m, standby on-call and dev leads. Good luck :rocket:
